script: Spread and total were not saved, so this script is form-only. Buffalo's weeks 2-4 were a James Cook game (57 carries, 364 yards) with Josh Allen adding 23 rushes for 99, while LA rode Kyren Williams (43 carries, 253 yards; 22 targets, 149 yards) and Davante Adams (32 targets, 364 yards, 563 air yards). Expect Cook volume into a Rams front allowing 3.96 YPC, and LA to throw at a Bills defense that has allowed 17 passes of 20+ on 158 attempts.
who_goes_off: Davante Adams is the one who should go off: 364 receiving yards on 32 targets over weeks 2-4 (121.3 per game) into Buffalo's 8.37 YPA right and 8.13 YPA middle. Kyren Williams is the chain-mover at 84.3 rush yards and 49.7 receiving yards per game against a Bills run defense that has allowed 14 runs of 10+ and 4.12 YPC.
weak_spot: Buffalo's hole is the middle and the right, not a blanket outside-CB problem: 8.13 YPA on 30 middle attempts and 8.37 YPA on 59 right attempts, plus 17 explosives. LA has no soft spot to attack — 4.64 YPA middle (25 att), 5.0 left (53 att), 4.78 right (49 att), only 5 passes of 20+ on 136 attempts, and 3.96 rush YPC with just 8 runs of 10+.
injury_fallout: No injuries were saved for BUF@LA, so there is no absence to reprice. Usage to trust is the last three games: Davante Adams 32 targets, Kyren Williams 43 carries and 22 targets, Tyler Higbee 17 targets for 129 yards, James Cook 57 carries, and Puka Nacua only 12 targets for 125 yards.
qb_vs_blitz: Josh Allen does not care that LA blitzes 32%: 0.28 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=42) versus 0.26 with no blitz. Matthew Stafford does care that Buffalo blitzes 33%: -0.33 EPA vs blitz (n=44) versus 0.19 with no blitz, which should push checkdowns to Kyren Williams (22 targets, 149 yards) and Tyler Higbee (17 targets) when the Bills heat him up.

picks.why: Adams has 364 yards on 32 targets over three games, nearly double the 62.5 line, and Buffalo has allowed 8.37 YPA right and 8.13 middle plus 17 explosives. Even if Stafford's -0.33 EPA vs a 33% Bills blitz cuts the shot rate, 10.7 targets a game only needs about 6 yards each to clear 62.5, and his weeks 2-4 rate was 11.4 yards per target.

Kyren's last three are 253 rush plus 149 receiving (134 per game) against a 96 line. Buffalo allows 4.12 YPC and 14 runs of 10+, and his 22 targets are the checkdown when Stafford faces blitz at -0.33 EPA. A regressed 14-carry day at the Bills' 4.12 YPC is about 59 rush yards, and 40 receiving still clears 96.
